CustomField.label: Guest Stats Real-Time Updates
CustomField.description: When ticked, Guest 360 statistics are refreshed shortly after a booking, booking party or charge changes (one background job per save). Off by default: the nightly job keeps the statistics current. Edit on the org-level PMS Settings record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Refresh Guest 360 statistics within moments of a booking, party or charge change. Off = nightly refresh only.
